speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Actinic Keratosis. The biopsy findings of hyperkeratosis, parakeratosis, solar elastosis, and atypical keratinocytes confined to the epidermis, combined with your history of outdoor activities and a scaly plaque on the dorsal hand, are diagnostic. Given your history of diabetes and hypertension, I recommend ongoing sun protection and monitoring for progression to squamous cell carcinoma.
